title: Engineer II, Software Development
description: Where Ambition Meets Innovation At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad. Join us as we create something extraordinary together. Job Overview: The Engineer II, Software Development role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications with a primary focus on front-end architecture using Angular. This position requires deep front-end expertise combined with practical back-end development experience in .NET and deployment within AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of front-end development experience and operates comfortably across the full application stack, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, performant, and cloud-native solutions. Responsibilities: Design and develop modern, responsive web applications using Angular and TypeScript Implement scalable front-end architectures, reusable component libraries, and state management patterns Collaborate with product, business and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET Core / .NET Deploy, monitor, and support applications within AWS environments Ensure application security standards, including authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth2, JWT) Optimize performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices Participate in code reviews and uphold engineering standards and best practices Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across front-end and back-end layers What are we looking for? We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness , act with integrity , and are driven to help our clients succeed . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in front-end application development using Angular and TypeScript. Experience with Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and developing applications using .NET Core/.NET (C#). Experience deploying and supporting applications on AWS. Understanding of web security, performance optimization, and responsive design principles. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines. Preferences : Experience with microservices architecture Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployments Experience with AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, and CloudFront Knowledge of automated testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma, Cypress, xUnit) Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments Exposure to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation) Technical Environment: Front End: Angular, TypeScript, Javascript Back End: .NET Core / .NET (C#) Cloud: AWS DevOps: CI/CD, Git, Docker Architecture: RESTful APIs, distributed systems LPL Global Business Services, LLP - PRIVACY POLICY

title: Software Engineer III- React, Micro frontend, AWS and Java
description: JOB DESCRIPTION We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Auto Finance you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives. Job responsibilities Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness. Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation. Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture Full-Stack Feature Delivery: Design, build, and deploy high-performance web applications using React for the front end and Java for the back end. API & Microservices Architecture: Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs and microservices in Java Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability Front-End Mastery: Extensive experience with React.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend build tools. Back-End Expertise: Robust background in Java, including framework proficiency with Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Hibernate AI & Engineering Acumen: Proven experience connecting applications to AI APIs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, or working with orchestration frameworks Data Systems: Experience designing schemas for both traditional relational SQL/NoSQL databases and vector search indexing. Soft Skills & Collaboration: Agile/Scrum/Kanban team experience, Git version control expertise, and a passion for staying on the cutting edge of AI advancements Understanding of application resiliency. Proficiency in automation and continuous delivery methods. Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle. Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security. Demonstrated proficiency in software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.). Emerging knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.) Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security. Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices. Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Exposure to Python ABOUT US

title: SAC UX / Reporting Developer
description: Company Description Empowering Global Talent in Life Sciences Transformation Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health. With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions. Focused on S4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake. Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality. This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan remotely and be able to travel to Yamagata upon the client’s requests. We are looking for a potential candidate who can lead the workstream at the client's side as well as large projects in the near future. At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients. As we are still in the exciting early stages of building our presence in Japan, joining Fusion means you won’t just be another consultant - you will be an initiating member helping shape our Japan growth story locally. You will have the opportunity to work on projects with truly global clients, where diverse perspectives and cross-border collaboration are the norm. You will be acting as the bridge between the global English-speaking business and potentially Japanese speaking local operations. With this comes a high level of accountability and ownership, empowering you to directly influence outcomes and see the tangible impact of your work. Job Description We are looking for an experienced SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) UX / Reporting Developer to design, develop, and optimize interactive reporting solutions, dashboards, and user-friendly analytical applications within a complex SAP environment. The role focuses on delivering intuitive user interfaces, advanced data visualizations, and efficient reporting capabilities to support business analytics, performance monitoring, and decision-making processes. Working closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and business stakeholders, the developer ensures high-quality reporting solutions that combine strong usability, reliable data integration, and optimal application performance. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud Stories, interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reporting interfaces. Create intuitive and user-friendly reporting solutions using SAC visualization capabilities, advanced design features, and UX best practices. Develop and enhance interactive components, including charts, tables, filters, input controls, and navigation functionalities. Implement custom application logic and interactive features using SAC scripting and JavaScript where required. Design and optimize reporting models, calculations, measures, and KPIs to support complex business reporting requirements. Integrate SAC reporting solutions with SAP Datasphere, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, and other enterprise data sources. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into functional dashboards and analytical applications. Optimize dashboard performance, data visualization efficiency, and overall user experience across different reporting scenarios. Troubleshoot reporting issues, validate data accuracy, and ensure consistency between source systems and SAC applications. Support testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, deployment, and continuous improvement of reporting solutions. Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) , particularly reporting, dashboard development, and data visualization. Proven experience developing SAC Stories, interactive dashboards, analytical applications, and reporting solutions. Solid understanding of SAC visualization capabilities, calculated measures, dimensions, filters, and input controls. Experience with SAC application scripting, JavaScript, and advanced interactive reporting functionalities. Strong knowledge of UI/UX design principles, dashboard usability, and data visualization best practices. Experience integrating SAC with SAP Datasphere, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, or other enterprise data platforms. Understanding of analytical data modeling, reporting structures, KPIs, and business intelligence concepts. Experience optimizing SAC dashboard performance, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring reporting accuracy. Familiarity with SAP Datasphere data models, semantic layers, and analytical datasets would be advantageous. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders. Additional Information Offered benefits Great package: We provide a competitive salary and benefits package, along with an outstanding work environment that fosters long-term career development opportunities. People Focus: Unite with the best global talent in life sciences, empowered to grow and collaborate in a vibrant environment. Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success. Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops, academies and trainings - inhouse workshops und training (optional) Invest in Your Learning: Access CHF 1,500 (approx. 280k JPY) annually for professional development Corporate culture and work life balance Flat hierarchies: Speak your mind and grow with close mentoring by senior leaders Remote workstyle: Work from anywhere in Japan (if client project allows) Working location: Temp office in Shinbashi/Client or Project site Work flex: Enjoy 25 days of flexibility to work from your preferred global location (under client’s permission) Annual vacations: of up to 20 days (depending on seniority) Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance, with flexibility beyond standard holiday allowances. Connect as a Team: We use our team’s integration budget to meet, collaborate, and bond Celebrate Your Birthday: Receive a special gift from Fusion on your birthday Anniversary bonus program: Receive substantial bonuses on special work anniversaries (5, 10, 15 years) Bonus programs: 10% annual performance bonus, based on company KPIs. Refer Talent reward program (up to Director) : Offers bonuses if your referral is hired by Fusion Truly Global: Join a truly global organization where mutual support, teamwork, and diversity drive our collective success.
